description:
[read-only] n per arm, pooled reach engagement rate, a 90% interval and a hedged verdict (likely_winner, no_clear_winner or not_enough_data). Missing numbers are "not reported" (null), never 0. Say "likely", never "proven".
(Wraps GET /api/v2/experiments/{id}/readout.)
name: get_experiment_readout
title: Experiment readout
